sql.single: SELECT id,a,b,c FROM m INDEXED BY m_abc WHERE a IN (?1,?2,NULL) AND b IN (3,2,1) AND c IN (5,4,3,2,1,NULL)
sql.left: SELECT x.id,y.id FROM m x LEFT JOIN m y INDEXED BY m_abc ON y.a IN (x.a,x.a,NULL) AND y.b IN (3,2,1) AND y.c IN (5,4,3,2,1,NULL) AND y.id=x.id WHERE x.id IN (1,2,3,4,5) ORDER BY x.id,y.id
sql.left-unmatched: SELECT x.id,y.id FROM m x LEFT JOIN m y INDEXED BY m_abc ON y.a IN (x.a,x.a,NULL) AND y.b IN (3,2,1) AND y.c IN (5,4,3,2,1,NULL) AND y.id=x.id AND y.id<>5 WHERE x.id IN (1,2,3,4,5) ORDER BY x.id,y.id
